text: Build RSS subscription engine for agent information streams
description: Implement subscription management system where agent can subscribe to RSS/Atom feeds and check them during DISCOVERING state. Store subscriptions in .bowman/subscriptions.json with feed URL, tags, check frequency, last checked timestamp. During discovery, fetch new items from feeds and generate aims or context from relevant content. Examples: blog posts about tech stack, library release notes, documentation updates.

status.comment: Cancelled 24 July 2026: a persistent RSS subscription subsystem is speculative infrastructure without a validated user, feed, or decision it improves. Create concrete research aims tied to current missions instead; revive only when recurring monitoring has a named source and measurable value.

reflection: Kept as cancelled context rather than deleting it. The loop already has access to current web research through capable agents; continuously ingesting feeds risks graph noise and maintenance cost before a real workflow demands it.
